target: self.root / human-surface Frank v0.1 fully operational on accepted Hostinger Ubuntu VPS
program_rule: All research/build/test domains are components of Frank v0.1. No H1/H2/H3 or separate GitHub/Reference/Clay Harness product gates exist.

legacy_evidence.law: Historical work remains evidence and may satisfy component subchecks only when its receipt still matches current Frank v0.1 semantics.

F-V01-01-IDENTITY-SERVER-BINARY.goal: Canonical self.root server-binary/state-lineage identity, external Andreas/Gabriel/client/token/Clay/peer relations, stale-clone rejection and restart/migration continuity.
F-V01-01-IDENTITY-SERVER-BINARY.blocker: Current frankv0.1 main still contains stale pre-self.root identity semantics; direct conformance discriminator fails.

F-V01-02-CLAYCODE-COMPILER-RUNTIME.goal: General-purpose ClayCode parser, canonical IR, typed IR, type/effect, evaluator, compiler/lowering, runtime/FFI/stdlib sufficient to execute real Frank v0.1 components.

F-V01-03-COGNITIVE-LOOP-CORE.goal: One executable Frank v0.1 cognitive loop-core with observation, self/world/memory, prospection, control pressures, GWT, Needle/tool routing, outcome verification, causal credit, reward/state update and provenance-bound re-entry.

F-V01-04-UNIFIEDDB-STATE-CONTINUITY.goal: Authoritative typed Frank v0.1 state, transactions, epochs, provenance, replay, checkpoints, recovery and model-visible bounded assemblies.

F-V01-05-GWT-HYPERPOSITION-TOPOLOGY.goal: Causally measurable GWT plus unresolved-alternative/Hyperposition mechanisms and derived topology used by Frank v0.1 without truth or authority promotion.

F-V01-06-DIGITAL-RETINA-MVC.goal: Integrated multimodal perception with provenance-bound VisualPercept/PerceptualField plus adaptive user-specific MVC, open-set behavior, bounded updates, rollback and resource measurements.

F-V01-07-NEEDLE-TRANSLATOR.goal: Needle boundary plus intelligent state-aware German <-> ClayCode translator with self.root <-> Frank mapping and zero semantic/authority drift on hard fields.

F-V01-08-TOKEN-API-CLIENTS.goal: Production token-authenticated API on target VPS with scoped caller intent, client/session provenance, health/readiness, concurrency, cancellation, idempotency and multimodal ingress.

F-V01-09-EFFECT-AUTHORITY.goal: Default-allow authenticated non-destructive action path plus deterministic ClayCode gates for destructive/security-sensitive effects, verified outcomes and replay protection.

F-V01-10-PROACTIVE-AGENCY-WEB.goal: Persistent interests/goals/checkpoints/heartbeat, bounded autonomous read-only research/experiments, action bias and structurally non-authoritative open-web ingress.

F-V01-11-MEMORY-REWARD-GOALS.goal: Long-horizon memory, reward/control successor, verified outcome + causal credit plasticity, goal persistence and anti-stagnation/overcoupling controls.

F-V01-12-TOOLS-PEERS-BODY-CAPABILITIES.goal: Current capability/body model including connected clients/tools and external strong-peer routes as typed capabilities, never SELF or authority by presence.

F-V01-13-SECURITY-RECOVERY-OBSERVABILITY.goal: Crash/restart/rollback/quarantine/rebuild, identity continuity, stale-state rejection, prompt/tool-result injection resistance, telemetry and complete reproducible receipts.

F-V01-14-TRAINING-DATA-HELDOUT.goal: Freeze final Clay-native training and held-out/eval corpus for Frank v0.1 without automatically starting paid/final training.

F-V01-15-FINAL-MODEL.goal: Owner-authorized final validated Clay-native model integrated into the Frank v0.1 binary/runtime.
F-V01-15-FINAL-MODEL.blocker: Explicit project-owner authorization required before paid/final training.

F-V01-16-END-TO-END-ACCEPTANCE.goal: Exact finished Frank v0.1 on target VPS passes full identity/API/translation/agency/multimodal/effect/security/recovery/resource/adversarial acceptance and has no open P0/P1 release blockers.
